dossier.purpose: Syft (Anchore) is a Go CLI and Go library that generates a Software Bill of Materials from container images (Docker/Podman daemon, registries, docker/OCI archives and layouts, Singularity SIF), directories, files and archives (README.md:7,22-24; cmd/syft/internal/commands/scan.go:46-65). Output formats: syft-json, CycloneDX (JSON/XML), SPDX (JSON/tag-value), a GitHub dependency-snapshot JSON, purls, table/text and templates (syft/format/encoders.go:56-74). It also has an experimental format converter and an `attest` command that shells out to cosign to publish in-toto SBOM attestations for registry images (cmd/syft/internal/commands/convert.go:54, attest.go:104-229). The repository also contains the project's own CI/release pipeline (zizmor, CodeQL via reusable workflow, Dependabot, SHA-pinned actions, cosign-signed checksums), which is documented below as evidence for the CI/supply-chain needs.

claims.claim: A CLI tool and Go library for generating a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) from container images and filesystems; 'Exceptional for vulnerability detection when used with a scanner like Grype'.
Generates SBOMs for container images, filesystems and archives (full list of scan targets is on an external docs page).
Supports dozens of packaging ecosystems (Alpine apk, Debian dpkg, RPM, Go, Python, Java, JavaScript, Ruby, Rust, PHP, .NET and many more).
Supports OCI, Docker, Singularity and more image formats.
Works seamlessly with Grype for vulnerability scanning.
Multiple output formats (CycloneDX, SPDX, Syft JSON and more), including the ability to convert between SBOM formats.
Create signed SBOM attestations using the in-toto specification.
Quickest install is `curl -sSfL https://get.anchore.io/syft | sudo sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin`.
Installation docs (external page) list more ways to get Syft, including Homebrew, Docker, Scoop, Chocolatey, Nix and more.
Basic usage: `syft alpine:latest` for a container image and `syft ./my-project` for a directory.
Get an SBOM with `syft <image> -o cyclonedx-json`, or write several to files with `-o spdx-json=./spdx.json -o cyclonedx-json=./cdx.json`.
Syft development is sponsored by Anchore and released under the Apache-2.0 License; commercial support is available from Anchore.
CI status badge points at the 'Validations' workflow (validations.yaml).
Contributions and issues are encouraged; contributor docs, CLI docs, configuration docs and JSON schema docs live on oss.anchore.com (external).

readme.telemetry_and_network: No telemetry/analytics code found (searches for telemetry/analytics/sentry/segment/posthog/mixpanel hit only unrelated identifiers). One default-on outbound call: an update check that GETs https://toolbox-data.anchore.io/syft/releases/latest/VERSION with User-Agent 'syft <version>' (cmd/syft/internal/commands/update.go:22-28,92-98). It is enabled by default (cmd/syft/internal/options/update_check.go:11), runs in PreRunE of scan, attest and convert (scan.go:101, attest.go:67, convert.go:60), is skipped for non-production/SNAPSHOT builds (update.go:63-66,85-90) and is disabled with `check-for-app-update: false` (the repo's own tests set SYFT_CHECK_FOR_APP_UPDATE=false, test/cli/utils_test.go:110). The production Docker image ships CA certs for this HTTPS call (Dockerfile:5-6). Other network use: pulling images from a Docker/Podman daemon or registry (scan.go:47-58); 'snap' sources via api.snapcraft.io (syft/source/snapsource/snapcraft_api.go:30-31); opt-in enrichment via --enrich/config, default off (cmd/syft/internal/options/catalog.go:267-269), which can query Maven Central (syft/pkg/cataloger/java/config.go:25), npm (syft/pkg/cataloger/javascript/config.go:3), PyPI (syft/pkg/cataloger/python/config.go:3) and the Go module proxy (syft/pkg/cataloger/golang/config.go:14); opt-in vcpkg git clone (cmd/syft/internal/options/cpp.go:15-16); `syft attest` needs cosign on PATH and registry write access, and in keyless mode defers to whatever services cosign contacts (attest.go:104-106,217-229). No account or API key is required for core scanning; private-registry credentials go through `syft login`, which reuses crane's auth login (cli.go:53). A local cache of downloaded content defaults to $XDG_CACHE_HOME/syft with a 7-day TTL (options/cache.go:68-93). Installation contacts get.anchore.io, GitHub releases and a raw.githubusercontent.com fallback (install.sh:8-10,871-873).

code.architecture: CLI (cmd/syft): main.go -> cli/cli.go builds a cobra/anchore-clio app; commands in cmd/syft/internal/commands/ (scan, attest, convert, cataloger, update), flags/config in cmd/syft/internal/options/, terminal UI in cmd/syft/cli/ui/. Library (syft/): get_source.go resolves user input through source providers (syft/source/sourceproviders/source_providers.go: stereoscope-backed images, directory, file, snap, OCI model); create_sbom.go + create_sbom_config.go run the selected catalogers (default tag set is `image` for images and `directory` for dirs/files, create_sbom_config.go:478-489; image scope defaults to squashed, with all-layers and deep-squashed available, syft/source/scope.go:11-16) through internal/task/ (package_tasks.go registers 67 package-cataloger factories, 4 deprecated), plus file catalogers (syft/file/) and relationship tasks. Per-ecosystem catalogers live in syft/pkg/cataloger/<ecosystem>/ (67 entries across 37 capabilities.yaml files); this includes `github-actions-usage-cataloger` and `github-action-workflow-usage-cataloger`, which read `uses:` in .github/workflows/*.y(a)ml and .github/actions/*/action.y(a)ml and run by default on directory scans (syft/pkg/cataloger/githubactions/cataloger.go:11-22; internal/task/package_tasks.go:181-182). Package model in syft/pkg/, SBOM model in syft/sbom/, encoders/decoders in syft/format/<format>/ (syftjson, cyclonedxjson/xml, spdxjson/tagvalue, github, purls, table, text, template). The SBOM records tool name/version and the configuration used (syft/create_sbom.go:51-66). Versioned syft-json schemas are in schema/json/ (current 16.1.11, internal/constants.go:6); vendored CycloneDX schemas for validation in schema/cyclonedx/. Build/test tooling: Makefile -> .make/main.go (anchore/go-make v0.8.1) + Taskfile.yaml syft-specific tasks; tests in test/ (cli, compare, install) and cmd/syft/internal/test/integration/.
code.packaging_and_release: Release is a manual workflow_dispatch (.github/workflows/release.yaml:10-28), gated by a check-gate over 7 named checks (release.yaml:39-49; can be bypassed with the skip-checks input, release.yaml:24-28,40), runs in `environment: release` (release.yaml:61) with admin approval (RELEASE.md:23-24), and calls `make ci-release` (release.yaml:104-119; implemented in anchore/go-make, not in this tree) which drives GoReleaser v2 (.goreleaser.yaml:1). Artifacts: static binaries (CGO_ENABLED=0) for linux amd64/arm64/ppc64le/riscv64/s390x, darwin amd64/arm64 (signed + notarized with quill, .goreleaser.yaml:35-39), windows amd64/arm64 (zip) (.goreleaser.yaml:12-57); .deb/.rpm (.goreleaser.yaml:59-64); Homebrew tap anchore/homebrew-syft (.goreleaser.yaml:66-74); 4 Docker variants (production scratch, nonroot, debug, debug-nonroot) x 5 platforms pushed to docker.io/anchore/syft and ghcr.io/anchore/syft (.goreleaser.yaml:76-157; Dockerfile, Dockerfile.nonroot, Dockerfile.debug, Dockerfile.debug-nonroot); a syft-json SBOM per archive made with the binny-managed syft (.goreleaser.yaml:159-168); the checksums file is signed with cosign keyless `sign-blob` into a Sigstore bundle (.goreleaser.yaml:170-179; `id-token: write` at release.yaml:76). install.sh always verifies the archive's sha256 against checksums.txt (install.sh:684-687) and verifies the bundle with `cosign verify-blob` (certificate identity https://github.com/anchore/syft/.github/workflows/release.yaml@refs/heads/main, GitHub OIDC issuer) only when -v is given (install.sh:589-619,651-675,812); bundles are used from v1.53.0 (install.sh:22). No build-provenance or in-toto attestation for binaries/images: images are built with `--provenance=false` and `sbom: "false"` (.goreleaser.yaml:110-115), there is no docker-signing section, and no actions/attest*, SLSA generator or `attestations: write` permission exists in .github. release.yaml:121-125 additionally runs anchore/sbom-action on go.mod to produce sbom.spdx.json (continue-on-error: true). The install script is published to R2/S3 through the anchore/workflows reusable workflow (release.yaml:127-142). Target cadence 1-2 weeks (RELEASE.md:9-11); retraction procedure at RELEASE.md:27-37.
code.tests_and_ci: Frameworks: Go testing + testify, go-snaps snapshots (cmd/syft/cli/ui/__snapshots__/), golden files for format encoders (Taskfile.yaml:110-117), docker-built image fixtures cached as an OCI artifact pulled with ORAS (Taskfile.yaml:19; .binny.yaml:16-22). Approx. 504 *_test.go files of ~1,240 .go files (testdata fixtures included): integration tests in cmd/syft/internal/test/integration/ (28 files), CLI tests in test/cli/ (20 files; need SYFT_BINARY_LOCATION snapshot binary, .make/main.go:82-98), shell tests of install.sh in test/install/ (Linux containers + macOS), acceptance comparison in test/compare/. SBOM validity is checked against CycloneDX XSD/JSON schema (schema/cyclonedx/Makefile:3-11), cyclonedx-cli and digest-pinned SPDX tools-java validators (test/cli/cyclonedx_valid_test.go:91-132; test/cli/spdx_tooling_validation_test.go:14-15). Unit coverage gate 62% and race detector in CI (.make/main.go:29-33,176-194); drift checks for JSON schema and cataloger capabilities (.github/scripts/json-schema-drift-check.sh, capability-drift-check.sh). Lint: golangci-lint with 25 linters incl. gosec/staticcheck/revive plus gci/gofmt (.golangci.yaml:3-31,113-128) via `make static-analysis` (validations.yaml:46-47; the generic lint task lives in go-make). Four workflows, each with top-level `permissions: {}` and per-job grants: validations.yaml (PR, push to main, manual: Static analysis, Unit tests Linux + Windows [Windows runs a curated subset, .make/main.go:100-115], Integration tests, Build snapshot artifacts, Acceptance Linux/Mac, CLI tests Linux); release.yaml (manual); codeql.yaml (push/PR to main + weekly cron; reusable anchore/workflows codeql.yaml@7212994d... with security-events: write, codeql.yaml:13-21); validate-github-actions.yaml (zizmorcore/zizmor-action@cc914d7f... v0.6.4, `inputs: .github`, `advanced-security: true`, `security-events: write # for uploading SARIF results`, validate-github-actions.yaml:15-32; config .github/zizmor.yml). All 28 external `uses:` refs are pinned to 40-hex commit SHAs with version comments (8 more are local ./ refs). .github/dependabot.yml:5-39 covers gomod (/, /.make) and github-actions (/, /.github/actions/*), weekly on Friday, 7-day cooldown, no docker ecosystem. No actionlint or other workflow syntax/expression/run-script linter exists in the repo. Linux build/test jobs run on runs-on.com-managed AWS runners (validations.yaml:30); the s3 cache is deliberately omitted on PR runs to prevent cache poisoning (validations.yaml:28-29); aggregator, zizmor, Windows and macOS jobs use GitHub-hosted runners.

code.security_policy: SECURITY.md: only the most recent release receives security updates (SECURITY.md:5); report privately to security@anchore.com (SECURITY.md:9-14; fuller policy on oss.anchore.com, :16); trust boundary - Syft is not designed to scan malicious content and confusion/omission caused by malicious inputs is not treated as a vulnerability, whereas arbitrary code execution, secret leakage, directory traversal and permanent temp-space exhaustion are (SECURITY.md:18-36).

claim_checks.claim: README badge advertises the 'Validations' workflow as the project's checks.
claim_checks.evidence: .github/workflows/validations.yaml exists and runs static analysis, unit (Linux + Windows subset), integration, snapshot build, acceptance (Linux/Mac) and CLI tests (validations.yaml:19-277); the release gate requires 7 of its named checks to have passed (release.yaml:39-49).

risks: Release provenance/attestation gap: only the checksums file is signed (cosign keyless Sigstore bundle, .goreleaser.yaml:170-179). Container images are built with `--provenance=false` and `sbom: "false"` (.goreleaser.yaml:110-115) and have no signing section; no actions/attest*, SLSA generator or `attestations: write` exists in .github (grep). The only workflow-level SBOM step is anchore/sbom-action on go.mod with continue-on-error: true (release.yaml:121-125). `syft attest` (a user feature) needs an external cosign and a registry image (attest.go:104-106,250-252) and has no end-to-end test.

No workflow syntax/expression linter: no actionlint (or equivalent) appears anywhere in the repo; only zizmor (security audit) runs on workflows (validate-github-actions.yaml:15-32). Concrete miss: validations.yaml:202 and :209 reference `steps.install-test-image-cache` but no step in .github defines that id, so 'Load test image cache' can never run and the cache-miss step always runs. .github/zizmor.yml:6 ignores detect-schema-changes.yaml, which does not exist in this tree, and .github/scripts/labeler.py refers to pull_request_target although no workflow invokes it. zizmor's pass/fail gating is stated to be a repo ruleset outside the tree (validate-github-actions.yaml:30), so it cannot be verified here.

Pinning gaps outside actions and Go modules: release Docker bases are floating distroless tags (gcr.io/distroless/static-debian13:latest / :debug / :nonroot / :debug-nonroot; Dockerfile:2, Dockerfile.debug:2, Dockerfile.nonroot:2, Dockerfile.debug-nonroot:2) and dependabot.yml has only gomod and github-actions ecosystems (dependabot.yml:5-39), so image bases and .binny.yaml tool pins (yajsv, oras, yq; .binny.yaml:7-30) are not covered by it. cosign/goreleaser/golangci-lint/quill/syft versions live in go-make's embedded .binny.yaml and are not visible here (.binny.yaml:3-6).

Build and CI logic sits partly outside this tree: Makefile delegates to `go run -C .make` using anchore/go-make v0.8.1 (.make/go.mod:5; .make/main.go:9-31), and CodeQL, check-gate, check-version-available and release-install-script are reusable workflows from anchore/workflows v0.8.0 (SHA-pinned: codeql.yaml:16, release.yaml:35,44,132), so what `make static-analysis` / `make ci-release` and those workflows actually run cannot be audited from this checkout. go.mod requires `go 1.26.8` (go.mod:3) while CI's configured Go is 1.26.2 (.github/actions/bootstrap/action.yaml:11-12; validations.yaml:104) and no GOTOOLCHAIN setting appears in repo build files.

Release credentials and controls: the release job uses long-lived secrets (Docker Hub PAT, TAG_TOKEN, Apple signing cert and notary key, Homebrew-tap token; release.yaml:94-95,107-119) plus R2/S3 keys for the install-script job (release.yaml:136-142), and its checkout sets `persist-credentials: true` (release.yaml:81) while every other checkout uses false. The check-gate can be skipped with the skip-checks dispatch input (release.yaml:24-28,40). Mitigations present: workflow-level `permissions: {}`, job-scoped grants, `environment: release` with manual approval (release.yaml:61; RELEASE.md:23-24), SHA-pinned actions.

Outputs are not reproducible byte-for-byte: CycloneDX gets a random URN serial number and wall-clock timestamp (syft/format/common/cyclonedxhelpers/to_format_model.go:42,212); SPDX gets a random UUID in documentNamespace and wall-clock `Created` (syft/format/internal/spdxutil/helpers/document_namespace.go:44; syft/format/common/spdxhelpers/to_format_model.go:151); github-json sets `scanned` to now and leaves job/sha/ref empty (syft/format/github/internal/model/model.go:19,26). Release binaries embed `{{.Date}}` as buildDate and no -trimpath flag is set (.goreleaser.yaml:19-26,92); no reproducible-build or SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH support or claim was found.

Network behaviour: a default-on update check calls https://toolbox-data.anchore.io/syft/releases/latest/VERSION from scan/attest/convert unless disabled (update.go:22-28; options/update_check.go:11; scan.go:101), so CI runs make an outbound call by default; opt-in --enrich can contact Maven Central, npm, PyPI and the Go proxy (options/catalog.go:267-269); the default image source tries a Docker daemon, then a registry (scan.go:47).

Scope/maintenance/platform: SECURITY.md supports only the latest release (SECURITY.md:5) and states Syft is not designed for malicious content (SECURITY.md:20); `convert` is experimental (convert.go:54); no MCP, HTTP API or Claude Code/Codex integration exists; WSL2 is undocumented; Windows CI runs only a curated unit-test subset (.make/main.go:100-115) and the macOS compare script runs the darwin amd64 binary (test/compare/mac.sh:42); breaking changes are deferred to 2.0 and some catalogers are deprecated for removal in v2.0 (.github/pull_request_template.md:15; internal/task/package_tasks.go:204-207). Licensing: stock Apache-2.0 whose copyright line is an unfilled placeholder (LICENSE:189); .bouncer.yaml:11-66 records manual license exceptions, e.g. spdx/tools-golang is dual-licensed Apache-2.0 / GPL-2.0-or-later and the project elects Apache-2.0 (.bouncer.yaml:25-31).

checks.note: README.md:36 is that exact command. install.sh:125-142 (uname_os_check) accepts linux and darwin, among other GOOS values. -b sets the install dir (install.sh:802), and the script downloads the release archive matching syft_*_<os>_<arch>.<format> from checksums.txt (install.sh:435,644). .goreleaser.yaml:50-53 publishes linux and darwin archives; only Windows is switched to zip (:54-57, matching install.sh:552). test/install/Makefile:34-35 defines ci-test-mac (unit-run + acceptance-local, which runs install.sh with -v -b and with plain -b, :21), and the macOS CI job calls it (validations.yaml:247-248 -> Taskfile.yaml:344-347).

LICENSE:1-3 is the Apache License, Version 2.0 header, followed by the standard unmodified terms (sections 1-9) and the appendix. The copyright line at LICENSE:189 is the unfilled template placeholder. README.md:79 and the image labels at .goreleaser.yaml:99,102 also say Apache-2.0. No other LICENSE/NOTICE/COPYING file exists outside testdata fixtures.

checks.statement: yes - .goreleaser.yaml:14-17 builds static linux/amd64 binaries (CGO_ENABLED=0, .goreleaser.yaml:10); also .deb/.rpm (.goreleaser.yaml:59-64) and linux/amd64 Docker images (.goreleaser.yaml:85-90); Linux CI jobs at .github/workflows/validations.yaml:68-87.
checks.note: .goreleaser.yaml:16-17 set goos [linux] with goarch including amd64; :10 sets CGO_ENABLED=0 and :22 sets -extldflags '-static'. :59-64 is nfpms with formats [rpm, deb]. :85-90 lists docker platforms including linux/amd64. validations.yaml:68-87 is the 'Unit tests (Linux)' job (make unit + capability drift check). The macOS arm64 platform citations (.goreleaser.yaml:28-39, validations.yaml:212-248, test/compare/mac.sh:42) were also opened and hold.

checks.statement: yes - `syft` binary with subcommands scan (root alias), packages (alias), cataloger list, attest, convert, version, config, login (cmd/syft/cli/cli.go:44-54; entry cmd/syft/main.go:22-34).
checks.note: cli.go:41-42 makes root an alias of scan. :45-54 add scan, Packages, Cataloger, Attest, Convert, clio VersionCommand, clio ConfigCommand and crane NewCmdAuthLogin ('syft login', :53). main.go:22-34 builds and runs cli.Application. The Use strings confirm the names (scan.go:93, packages.go:17, cataloger.go:13 + cataloger_list.go:56, attest.go:59, convert.go:52), and test/cli runs version and config (version_cmd_test.go:24, config_test.go:198). The login name comes from crane, outside this tree; the only in-tree evidence is the comment at cli.go:53. Omissions only, not errors: packages is marked Deprecated 'use `syft scan` instead' (packages.go:34), and `cataloger info` exists but is registered only when SYFT_EXP_CAPABILITIES=true (cataloger.go:21-24).

checks.statement: Multiple output formats (CycloneDX, SPDX, Syft JSON and more) - verified: yes, with CycloneDX JSON 1.2-1.7 / XML 1.0-1.7 default 1.7, SPDX tag-value 2.1-2.3 / JSON 2.2,2.3,3.0 default 2.3, github-json job/sha/ref unset and scope/relationship hard-coded.
checks.note: encoders.go:63-71 add syft-json, table, text, purls, github (ID 'github-json', github/encoder.go:11), cyclonedx-xml/json and spdx-json/tag-value; template is added only when a template path is set (:59-61). CycloneDX JSON covers 1.2-1.7, XML adds 1.0/1.1, and the default is 1.7 (cyclonedxutil/versions.go:20-44); cyclonedxjson/encoder.go:13,39 and cyclonedxxml/encoder.go:15,41 use these. SPDX is 2.2/2.3, plus 2.1 for tag-value only and 3.0 for JSON only, default 2.3 (spdxutil/versions.go:8,15-29). model.go:26 is the Job/Sha/Ref TODO and the struct literal leaves those unset; :187-193 return runtime/direct unconditionally.
